metadata.author: ARPOL × ESADE Consulting Team
metadata.note: All values updated from ARPOL_TCO_Model_Final.xlsx — client-confirmed actuals as of June 2026.

subcontract_annual_spend.source: Client (Manuel via Prof. Felipe) — 2026 actual: Contracurva €21,950 + Carcasa €65,980 + Acero €16,942 = €104,872

press_annual_opex.source: Client-confirmed (ARPOL) — €23/h press rate × 643 h/year (403h production + 240h setup/changeover, 2023). Labour + energy + maintenance on 25-yr-old press.

logistics_cost.source: Client-confirmed (ARPOL) — 2 trips/week × 3h × €23/h × 50 weeks. Range €7,000–€10,000. Eliminated under both insource scenarios.

scrap_rework_cost.source: Client-confirmed actual. Scrap falls materially under laser insourcing as the strip/press process is retired.

current_volume_units.source: Client — 2025 total units across all families; laser-cut subset (NEO, REP IBXR, FIX, INSTAL IBX) ~35,265 units

volume_growth_base.source: Derived from €4M→€8M plan by 2028. Supported by confirmed 2025 revenue €6,131,801.

eu_insource.eu_equipment_cost_note: Trumpf TruLaser 3030 fiber 6kW benchmark mid €220,000 (range €185,000–€270,000). Sources: Trumpf product portfolio & MM MaschinenMarkt trade press, 2023. Trumpf turnkey quote €600k incl. automation is not comparable to machine-only.

laser_power_kw.source: IPG resonator + auxiliary (chiller, extraction) supplier specifications, 6kW-class fiber system, 2024. Includes auxiliary loads.

electricity_rate.source: Eurostat nrg_pc_205, Spain 2025-S2, Band IC (500–1,999 MWh/year), all taxes included (I_TAX). €0.0971/kWh. Pulled 2025-05-25.

consumables_per_hr.source: VDMA consumables benchmarks (nozzles, lenses, assist gas) + supplier data, 2024. ~6% of machine CAPEX/yr at 1,800 hrs.

operator_wage_loaded.source: Eurostat lc_an_struc_r2, Spain NACE C Manufacturing; cross-checked vs INE Encuesta Anual de Coste Laboral. ~€20/hr fully loaded. Includes social charges.

sku_reduction_rate.source: Hypothesis from Manuel interview — coils unified by thickness; sheets serve more SKUs

discount_rate.source: Spanish SME WACC proxy (7–10% range); validate with ARPOL Finance (CFO Gadea Alonso-Peraita)

inflation_rate.source: ECB price-stability objective (2% medium-term) + near-term Eurozone consensus

payback_hurdle_years.source: Spanish SME benchmark (3–5 years); validate with ARPOL Finance

equipment_life_years.source: Spanish corporate tax depreciation tables, Ley 27/2014 — industrial machinery 8–10 year useful life
